# Peak with Priceless NYC

> > Peak with Priceless is a luxury rooftop restaurant and event venue on the 101st floor of 30 Hudson Yards, operated by TAO Group Hospitality, offering modern American cuisine and panoramic New York City skyline views.

Peak with Priceless NYC combines fine dining, private events, and cocktail experiences at one of Manhattan's highest venues. Located at Hudson Yards, the venue features multiple spaces including the main restaurant, Quin Bar, and the exclusive Sky Cellar for weddings and corporate gatherings.
